daily_wisdom: The market rewards those who take profits and punishes those who take hope. When a stock gives you a 20% gain in 3 days, sell half immediately - the market does not owe you the other 20%. Your job is not to be right about every trade. Your job is to make sure your winners are always bigger than your losers. Cut losses at 8-10%, ride winners to 25-50%, and repeat. That is the entire formula.
